groups.why_chosen: Small identical scenario CDFs each contribute one 99th-percentile point to a larger derived distribution below — a clean way to show how a summary distribution is built from samples.
groups.what_to_learn: Draw several identical small curve panels side by side, mark the one value harvested from each with a dot, then run a dashed arrow from each dot into the matching point on one larger derived curve below.
